meta.name: imagegen-frontend-web
meta.description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网站每个区块生成高质量设计参考图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站每个区块生成风格统一的设计参考图
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality design reference images for each website section
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need design reference images for each section of a website

howto.what: 让它按需求为网页的每个区块各生成一张独立的横版设计参考图：8 个区块就出 8 张，不合并成一张长图。它会变化构图、背景、CTA 风格和 hero 尺寸，并让全套图共用一套配色，产出前端可照着复刻的页面稿。
howto.when: 当你要求做 landing page、营销站或产品页设计稿时触发；若没说区块数量，landing page 默认出 6 张图，整站模板默认出 8 张。

say.text: 帮我做一套落地页设计参考图，8 个区块
say.note: 会输出 8 张图，每个区块一张

say.text: hero 别用左文右图，换几种构图
say.note: hero 会改用居中、叠图等布局

say.text: 这套图统一用深色配色
say.note: 所有区块共用一套深色配色

howto.what_en: Generates one separate horizontal design-reference image per page section — 8 sections means 8 images, never merged. It varies composition, backgrounds, CTA styles and hero scale while keeping one consistent palette, so developers or coding models can recreate the layout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a landing page, marketing site or product comp; with no section count, landing pages default to 6 images and full site templates to 8.

say_en.text: Make a landing page design reference set with 8 sections
Don't open the hero with left text / right image — vary it
say_en.note: Hero switches to centered or overlay layouts

say_en.text: Keep one dark palette across all images
say_en.note: Every section shares the same palette
